latest.module: M1 Ba Zi current/manual selection and exact solar-term boundaries
latest.scope: Numerical navigation and deterministic fixtures. Official fixed second expectations cover 2012 White Dew and 2050 Great Snow; 2026 boundaries are pinned engine regression values. Period/year rows retain the source library calendar-year convention; beforeStart is separately gated by the actual first start instant. No UI, service, archive, or publication operation is performed.

results.name: Official White Dew fixture has the fixed second and correct UTC offset
Official 2050 Great Snow fixture also resolves the next-year alias edge
White Dew is half-open: one second before, exact, and one second after
January Small Cold belongs to the previous solar-term year, not month one
Li Chun changes both solar-term year and month precisely at its second
A middle solar term does not start another month
Late Zi and civil midnight do not prematurely change month or year
All twelve intervals are contiguous across English next-year keys
1900 and 2099 input-year edges retain valid adjacent-year boundaries
UTC instants and boundaries do not depend on the machine timezone
Current navigation chooses the real current year and solar-term month
Legal manual selections remain unchanged across renders and Li Chun
Current mode refreshes at Li Chun and persists only four navigation fields
Invalid manual values and an empty initial selection fall back to current
Future birth is explicitly outside and never described as a current fortune
Dates after the final represented Li Chun year are explicitly outside
Official first-start date gates beforeStart even within its table start year
A January birth before Li Chun does not invent a missing earlier flow year
Zero-wait start skips the empty pre-start period without an invalid selection
Invalid helper arguments reject instead of creating fictitious periods
